what_this_is: The Workshop row for the tool in tools/what-is-waiting-on-me: everything waiting on a person, merged from the places they keep it.

payload.label: Show everything waiting on me
payload.job: Show everything waiting on this person that only they can do, gathered from every place it is kept: what their AIs asked them for, drafts to approve, work that is stuck, a sign-in, a decision
payload.description: Give sources (the places that hold things up, the person's own list: { id, label, title, where?, detail?, opens?, at?, most? }) and found (the records of each source, { <source id>: [{ id, value }] }, read from the person's account by the caller). A record waits when every where test holds (equals, in, present or absent on a field). Answers one card per waiting record, newest first, with the title, detail and the address it opens read from the record by the source's templates, a count for each source, and a sentence. A source with no records handed in is told as unread, never as nothing waiting. The tool reads no records and names no source: a new place is a new row.

title.description: A template over the record's fields, {path} holes

at.description: The field that holds when it started waiting

card.description: Additional card fields mapped from a dotted record path or {value} or {template}.

found.description: The records of each source, by source id

words.description: The sentences an answer says, over read-data/waiting-words.json

provenance.source: the app's Waiting on you answer, with its sources as the person's own rows

payload.label: Read what is waiting on me
payload.job: Gather every configured waiting source's cards from the records and reader results handed in
payload.description: Reads the person's record:waiting-sources rows over declared source DATA and gathers each source's cards from what the caller hands in: stored (the person's record:waiting-sources rows and the records of each kind a source reads, each { id, type, value }, read by the caller from the person's own store) and pages ({ [reader tool id]: [result, ...] }, each reader tool a source names run by the caller, in order, following its cursor). Uses the same source-row aggregator as what-is-waiting-on-me. A source whose records or pages were not handed in, a store query the handed-in records cannot answer, and a failed, partial or bounded read stay unread; complete is true only when every declared source is read whole with no skipped cards. Answers sections, finishes, source coverage and problems. The tool reads and writes nothing.

stored.description: The person's records this run reads, each { id, type, value }: the record:waiting-sources rows, and the records of each kind a source reads (record:waiting-on-you, post, calendar-task and the rest). What is not given is not there.

pages.description: The results of each reader tool a source names, by tool id, in the order the caller ran them: { "tool:my-notification-devices": [result, ...] }. What is not given is unread.

provenance.source: the app's Waiting on you answer, with its sources as the person's own rows

payload.label: Finish a waiting item
payload.job: Complete the declared action on the same persisted waiting record
payload.description: Works out the declared same-record completion of waiting records and answers the records that change as keep, each { id, type, value, expected } for the caller to store; it writes nothing. Read the records first from the person's own store (each { id, type, value }) and hand them in as records; hand in the person's record:waiting-sources records as sources when they added any. Refuses items whose source has another owner. The built-in asks action is the original Waiting on you list status Done transition; no other source status is guessed. Answers completed (the ids), changed (how many records change) and keep: each changed record as { id, type, value, expected }, expected being the record as it was read. Store each kept record in the person's own store, refused if the expected record has moved, then run tool:verify-waiting-on-me-completion on the records read back. A record already carrying this request_key's receipt answers completed with no write.

showed.description: What each finished round showed, by its exact card id.

records.description: The waiting records to complete, as the person's own store gives them: [{ id, type, value }].

sources.description: The person's record:waiting-sources records as the person's own store gives them, when they added sources of their own.

keep.description: The records that change, for the caller to store: { id, type, value, expected } for each, expected being the record as it was handed in (null for a new one), so a store refuses the write when it moved.

provenance.source: the app's Waiting on you answer, with its sources as the person's own rows

payload.label: Verify a waiting completion
payload.job: Read the same persisted target and verify the current effect of a waiting completion
payload.description: Checks, on the waiting records handed in (read them again from the person's own store after the keep, each { id, type, value }), the saved completion key and BLAKE3 effect identity against the source's declared fields, and answers completed/next_round only when that same effect still holds. A hidden card, unavailable feed or historical command result proves nothing here. Hand in the person's record:waiting-sources records as sources when they added any. Reads and changes nothing in the person's records.

records.description: The waiting records as read now, as the person's own store gives them: [{ id, type, value }].

sources.description: The person's record:waiting-sources records as the person's own store gives them, when they added sources of their own.

provenance.source: the app's Waiting on you answer, with its sources as the person's own rows
